title: Odile and the Letters
author: Wendell Ishikawa
blurb: Mirabel Dunmore, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
